# Interfaces

<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference`. Do not edit. -->

sdvarlink generates a package for every `io.systemd.*` Varlink interface in each supported systemd release (v257, v258, v260). This table lists the interfaces in **systemd v260**; each page shows methods, types and errors, and the systemd version that introduced them.

Import a versioned package to pin the oldest systemd you support, or `systemd/latest/<pkg>` to follow the newest release:

```go
import (
    "github.com/rossedman/sdvarlink/systemd/v257/resolve"   // pinned
    "github.com/rossedman/sdvarlink/systemd/latest/resolve" // newest
)
```
